description: Defines data structures and utility functions for handling wizard steps, options, and type conversions in a wizard-based user interface.

methods.name: decodeWizardStep
methods.description: Decodes a raw dictionary into a WizardStep object using JSON encoding/decoding.

methods.name: parseWizardOptions
methods.description: Parses raw options data into a list of WizardOption instances.

methods.name: wizardStatusString
methods.description: Extracts a trimmed, lowercased string status from an AnyCodable value.

methods.name: wizardStepType
methods.description: Retrieves the type string from a WizardStep's type property.

methods.name: anyCodableString
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to its string representation.

methods.name: anyCodableBool
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to a boolean.

methods.name: anyCodableArray
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to an array of AnyCodable.

methods.name: anyCodableEqual
methods.description: Checks equality between two AnyCodable values.
